integrity: All proof steps are given in the self-contained statement and analytic argument. The computer check is supplementary; finite testing is not used as proof. No independent validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: The condition is an exact Euclidean nonexpansive threshold, not an exact threshold for global asymptotic stability outside the proven range. The zero saturation case eta=0 is excluded. Residual historical literature coverage risk remains.
title: Sharp nonexpansive boundary and endpoint global attraction for the saturating Ikeda map
